statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range above 3.75 to 4.00 percent at its scheduled meeting concluding 2026-10-28. Reference: upper limit 4.00 percent at seal on 2026-09-17.
resolution: The Federal Reserve FOMC statement dated 2026-10-28 announces an increase to the federal funds target range; FRED DFEDTARU for 2026-10-29 exceeds 4.00. Reference: upper limit 4.00 percent at seal.
failure_condition: The FOMC meeting concluding 2026-10-28 ends with the federal funds target range unchanged or lowered.

statement: The Bank of England MPC raises Bank Rate above 3.75 percent at its scheduled announcement on 2026-11-05. Reference: Bank Rate 3.75 percent at seal on 2026-09-17.
resolution: The Bank of England Monetary Policy Summary dated 2026-11-05 announces Bank Rate above 3.75 percent, and Bank of England database series IUDBEDR for 2026-11-06 exceeds 3.75. Reference: 3.75 percent at seal.
failure_condition: The MPC decision announced 2026-11-05 leaves Bank Rate at or below 3.75 percent.

statement: The EIA Cushing WTI spot price falls below 90.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-18 and 2026-11-20. Reference: WTI 101.09 in the packet market snapshot on 2026-09-17.
resolution: FRED series DCOILWTICO shows at least one daily value below 90.00 dated between 2026-09-18 and 2026-11-20 inclusive. Reference: WTI 101.09 per packet snapshot at seal.
failure_condition: The EIA Cushing WTI spot price stays at or above 90.00 dollars per barrel on every trading day from 2026-09-18 through 2026-11-20.

statement: The Riksdag elects Magdalena Andersson prime minister of Sweden in a vote held between 2026-09-18 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Riksdagen.se records a prime-ministerial vote held between 2026-09-18 and 2026-10-30 in which the Speaker proposal of Magdalena Andersson is not rejected, meaning fewer than 175 members vote no.
failure_condition: Magdalena Andersson has not been confirmed as prime minister by any Riksdag vote held from 2026-09-18 through 2026-10-30.

statement: Democrat James Talarico receives more votes than Republican Ken Paxton in the Texas US Senate general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: The Texas Secretary of State official canvass of the 2026-11-03 general election shows Talarico with more US Senate votes than Paxton.
failure_condition: Paxton or any candidate other than Talarico receives the most votes in the 2026-11-03 Texas US Senate general election.

statement: The Russia sanctions and secondary-tariff bill named for the late Senator Lindsey Graham, which cleared the House 262-159 on 2026-09-16, becomes public law between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: Congress.gov shows the bill passed by the House 262-159 on 2026-09-16 with a Signed by President or Became Public Law action dated between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-16.
failure_condition: The bill is vetoed or has not been enacted by the end of 2026-10-16.

statement: A federal criminal charge of contempt of Congress under 2 U.S.C. 192 is filed against Leon Black in the US District Court for the District of Columbia between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: The D.D.C. docket via PACER or CourtListener shows a criminal case against Leon Black charging 2 U.S.C. 192, with a filing date between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-18.
failure_condition: No contempt-of-Congress criminal charge against Leon Black is filed in the District of Columbia federal court from 2026-09-17 through 2026-12-18.

statement: CISA adds CVE-2026-89026, the Issabel Framework hard-coded JWT signing key flaw, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-09-17 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON lists CVE-2026-89026 with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-17 and 2026-11-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-89026 is absent from the KEV catalog, or its date-added value falls outside 2026-09-17 through 2026-11-30.

statement: The United States and Iran conclude a ceasefire or cessation-of-hostilities agreement between 2026-09-18 and 2026-11-20 that both governments publicly confirm.
resolution: Reuters or AP reports that the US government and the Iranian government each confirmed a US-Iran ceasefire or cessation-of-hostilities agreement concluded between 2026-09-18 and 2026-11-20.
failure_condition: No US-Iran ceasefire or cessation-of-hostilities agreement accepted by both governments is concluded from 2026-09-18 through 2026-11-20.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 250 km of the epicenter of the 2026-09-17 M6.5 event 165 km W of Nikolski, Alaska (USGS us7000ti1p) between 2026-09-18 and 2026-11-30 UTC.
resolution: The USGS ComCat catalog lists at least one event of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 250 km of the us7000ti1p epicenter with an origin time between 2026-09-18 and 2026-11-30 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 250 km of the us7000ti1p epicenter from 2026-09-18 through 2026-11-30 UTC.
